# addon api reference

Look up the types and functions available to addon authors. Start with [Addon](Addon.md), [AddonManifest](AddonManifest.md), and [AddonContext](AddonContext.md), or follow [Creating your first addon](../addons/creating-your-first-addon.md).

For installed packages, use the [SideloadFactory](SideloadFactory.md) and the [shared SDK](sdk.md). Native modules use [NativeAddon](NativeAddon.md) and [NativeAddonContext](NativeAddonContext.md).
